workflow.summary: #474 rejected its frozen jump-by-curve selector while leaving broad short exposure as a research lead. #475 therefore evaluated the complete eligible 2010-2022 chronology with a frozen prequential procedure rather than tuning another short-regime rule.

The bounded gap was whether persistent after-cost value came from unconditional short exposure itself or from causal state selection, adaptive specialist weighting, model challengers, and risk vetoes that could improve on a simpler parent.

The search was bounded before scoring to 13 lanes: flat, always-short, trend/curve baselines, TimesFM/Kronos challengers, volatility/jump vetoes, one long challenger, a legacy-V3 reference, and a negative control. Parent-relative gates prevented complex lanes from receiving credit merely for positive absolute return.

Repository quantitative-research authority supported chronological point-in-time learning, fixed search budgets, baseline ladders, execution-aware evaluation, and multiplicity control. No post-result literature or narrative was permitted to rescue a failed frozen candidate.

The mechanism hypothesis separated a possible structural short premium from timing value: trend, curve, model forecasts, volatility/jump state, and adaptive lifetime evidence were allowed to add value only if they improved severe-stress performance relative to their declared simpler parent.

At least one eligible architecture would need positive base and severe after-cost return, recurring positive incremental severe return versus its parent, bounded concentration and drawdown, leave-best-period support, and multiplicity-adjusted evidence. The smallest architecture passing every frozen gate would be selected.

A passing result required recurring parent-relative edge rather than one-period concentration. Disconfirming outcomes included a strong simple benchmark with no statistically adequate recurrence, complex children that underperformed their parent, a losing adaptive path, or any future-invariance/protected-boundary failure.

The final no-scoring preflight aligned 3,072 unique eligible decisions from July 2010 through December 2022, verified strict future outcomes and PIT source identities, and confirmed the protected 2023+ reserve remained registered but unopened.

The exact design freeze was committed before scoring at 81066f40912b7c4aadcfde9152b5d717c286718e. The freeze bound engine, runner, market/session inputs, TimesFM/Kronos features, Programme 004 authority, candidate tree, cadences, costs, robustness gates, selection rule, and no-rescue rules.

The authoritative traversal ran once from the clean committed freeze across all 3,072 eligible rows, produced 564 learning events and 117,312 specialist-evidence rows, and persisted the complete decision, learning, candidate, adaptive, attribution, robustness, and invariance artifacts.

Adversarial future-invariance passed at both frozen cut points under a -37x suffix mutation; each mutated suffix left the earlier decision prefix unchanged. protected_confirmation_accessed remained false and the runtime result was bound to the immutable freeze commit.

No architecture passed all frozen gates. Always-short was the strongest raw lane at +112.775% base and +112.745% severe with 9/13 positive incremental years, bounded concentration, and +85.435% leave-best-year incremental severe return, but its sign-test evidence (p=0.1334; multiplicity-adjusted p=1.0 across 11 tests) failed the multiplicity gate. The adaptive learned path returned -16.55% base and -3.04% severe; every more complex child failed to establish positive parent-relative severe edge.

Not applicable for promotion or rescue: no frozen candidate cleared all gates. Additional narrative, feature search, threshold changes, or literature-driven reinterpretation is prohibited inside #475 after observing the authoritative path.

Conclude #475 with NO_SUFFICIENTLY_ROBUST_EDGE. The unconditional short lane remains a material structural-premium research lead, not a promoted edge; trend/curve timing, TimesFM/Kronos challengers, volatility/jump vetoes, the long challenger, legacy V3, and the adaptive controller did not establish incremental robust value over their simpler parents. Protected 2023+ confirmation remains sealed.

Do not rescue-tune #475 on the consumed 2010-2022 path. Any successor must be scientifically distinct, declare a new mechanism and bounded search before its own evaluation, preserve #475 negatives for the exact tested roles, and keep protected 2023+ evidence sealed until a separately authorized confirmation gate.

decisions.decision: Report no sufficiently robust promoted edge from the frozen #475 full-history prequential traversal. Retain always-short only as an unconfirmed structural-premium lead because it failed the multiplicity gate; do not rescue-tune the consumed 2010-2022 chronology and do not open protected 2023+ evidence.
